description: Exploit. First read the code. If the whitening bias already stops training before 25% of steps, close H2.6.3 without a run. Otherwise, on the H2.6.2 successor (or E027 if it is not kept), stop the whitening bias's gradient after 20% of steps (Hiverge; airbench96 trains it for 3/45 epochs). Use a third compiled step variant in which the whitening output is detached, so no input-grad of group 1's first conv and no whitening backward on the 31×31 maps. Group 1 still trains normally until the freeze. Anneal the whitening-bias LR to 0 by 20% of steps. Capture the new variant at every resolution it runs at (20/24/28/32 px) in build, with error_on_recompile on. Judge on held-out seeds 3–12 as well as seeds 0–2.
